name: studio3d
description: Generate 3D models locally on your NVIDIA GPU (photos, image or text to 3D), AI texturing, quad topology, automatic skeleton and talking mouth animation via Blender, and a model library Claude can reuse.
long_description: Requires Studio3D installed with: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahmad-ksa/3D/main/install.ps1 | iex

tools.name: studio3d_status
tools.description: GPU info, folders and whether a job is running.

tools.name: list_input_images
tools.description: List photos in the Studio3D inbox folder (newest first).

tools.name: generate_from_images
tools.description: Build a 3D model from 1-4 photos of the same object (front required; back/left/right improve accuracy). target_faces: 0 keeps full detail, 3000-30000 for game assets. size_mm: real-world size of the longest side (3D printing). topology='quad' gives clean all-quad topology (Blender QuadriFlow, OBJ/FB

tools.name: generate_from_image
tools.description: Build a 3D model from a single photo or drawing (object on a plain background works best).

tools.name: generate_from_text
tools.description: Build a 3D model from an ENGLISH text description of ONE object (e.g. 'a low-poly wooden treasure chest, game asset'). First use downloads ~10 GB.

tools.name: texture_model
tools.description: Paint an AI texture onto an existing (untextured) 3D model using a reference image.

tools.name: edit_model
tools.description: Clean / decimate (low-poly) / smooth / resize an existing model and export it. Note: decimating a textured model removes its texture.

tools.name: quad_remesh_model
tools.description: Convert a model to clean quad topology with Blender (QuadriFlow) — runs Blender hidden. Keeps the texture by re-baking it. Outputs OBJ + FBX (quads) and GLB.

tools.name: rig_model
tools.description: Add an automatic humanoid skeleton (19 bones, Unity/Mixamo names) with skin weights, using Blender in the background. Best for characters standing in T-pose or A-pose. Outputs FBX + GLB.

tools.name: lip_sync_model
tools.description: Make a rigged character talk: adds a jaw bone and animates the mouth from an audio file (wav/mp3/ogg/flac; path, inbox file name or URL). The model must have a Studio3D skeleton (rig_model first). Outputs GLB + FBX with the animation and a .blend with the sound.

tools.name: check_job
tools.description: Wait for / get the result of a running generation job.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Search the user's library of generated 3D models (newest first). query matches name, prompt or type ('rig', 'quad'...). Use this before generating something new.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Details, file paths and a 4-view preview image of one library model (id from list_models, or a path to one of its files).

tools.name: export_model
tools.description: Copy a library model into a folder for use in a project (e.g. 'C:/Projects/Game/Assets/Models'). formats: e.g. ['fbx'] or ['glb','obj']; omit to copy every format available. name: file name.

tools.name: open_in_blender
tools.description: Open a library model in a normal (visible) Blender window for the user to work on.

tools.name: rename_model
tools.description: Give a library model a friendly name (shown in the app and searchable).

tools.name: preview_model
tools.description: Render a 4-view preview image of any 3D model file so you can inspect it.

studio3d_dir.title: مجلد Studio3D
studio3d_dir.description: Leave empty: Studio3D is found automatically in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Studio3D
